checks: catalogue rejects duplicate IDs, unsafe asset paths, mismatched hashes and invalid walking poses
unverified model and forged GLB extras never enable clipping or collisions
correct byte-verification receipt enables one source clip and one collision
hidden model, hidden ancestor, detached object, disposal and receipt mismatch restore source state
verified LOD remains active and triggers a variant-bound revision
shared-site clipping is deduplicated and removed only after its last visible verified model
polygon holes and MultiPolygon membership remain open
partial vector replacement retains the other half of its source geometry and properties
unrelated Overture IDs, empty source IDs and already-rendered city coverage are not clipped
vector hole preservation and source-provider fallback retain source fragments
shader clipping triangulates a polygon hole without filling it and returns to zero
the actual 30-model catalogue merges with all 40 original entries and fits the clipping budget
scope: Synthetic contract and source-preservation cases; actual city GLB rendering, network failure and browser interaction are checked separately.
